an incoming request offers ACCEPT · DECLINE · BLOCK REQUESTS; an outgoing one offers CANCEL REQUEST
ACCEPT starts the Rivalry and the row moves to Active with 0–0–0
the active row shows YOUR RIVALRY RECORD, YOU LEAD 4–3, 1 tie, labelled as Challenge-comparison history
history: SINCE THIS RIVALRY BEGAN, a labelled past period, 2 wins in a row, pending Challenge 'waiting for them', rated/unrated per event
no private data in the rivalry surface: no email, rank, XP, id
CHALLENGE AGAIN hands off to a fresh Chaos Clash with the Rivalry context remembered
the opponent's public profile link appears only for the public opponent
END RIVALRY asks first and states the consequences
ending moves the row to Past, labelled Ended
START A RIVALRY on a completed comparison sends the request and the Rivalries list shows it as sent
keyboard: tab order reaches the controls; every new control class has a :focus-visible ring; reduced motion adds no animation
the composer has a role=img preview with alt text, a tablist for the two kinds and a live region for outcomes

emulation: Chromium device emulation (Playwright) — not a physical iPhone; real-device Safari is recorded separately when the owner tests
